name: PixelCard-TS-TW
blurb: Pixels reveal on hover with a radial wave animation emanating from center.
description: A canvas-based card where pixels gradually appear on hover and disappear on blur. Individual pixels animate in a wave pattern based on distance from center. Supports four color variants (default, blue, yellow, pink). Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
use_when: Interactive showcase cards where the reveal animation creates visual interest.
avoid_when: Accessibility-first contexts — no keyboard equivalent for the reveal effect without focus styles.
a11y: Card is tabbable (tabIndex=0 by default). Focus triggers the same reveal as hover. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
